d:
Jethalal confronts Bhide in the compound about the rotten Alphonso mangoes, arguing that as a paying customer, he has every right to complain and mockingly comparing the situation to Bhide's old mobile warranty dispute. An offended Bhide calls his uncle in Ratnagiri to report the insults.
Step into Jethalal’s world with Gada Electronics! Manage the shop, tackle quirky customers, and experience nonstop TMKOC-style fun.
Are you ready for the challenge?
